name: L0 里程碑验收流程
description: L0 制作委员会级里程碑验收流程，汇总所有审查结果并生成综合验收报告
author: Pipeline-Sys

scope_chapters.description: 验收范围-章节（逗号分隔，如 C0,C1）

scope_systems.description: 验收范围-系统（逗号分隔，如 dialogue,inventory）

nodes.name: 参数接收
nodes.expression: ({ acceptance_id: 'ACC-' + inputs.milestone_id + '-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10).replace(/-/g,''), milestone_id: inputs.milestone_id, started_at: new Date().toISOString(), period: { start: inputs.period_start || new Date(Date.now() - 30*24*60*60*1000).toISOString().slice(0,10), end: inputs.period_end || new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) } })

nodes.name: 收集审查记录
nodes.description: 扫描 reviews 目录获取所有审查记录
nodes.command: mkdir -p workflows/project/logs/reviews && for f in workflows/project/logs/reviews/*.json; do [ -f "$f" ] && cat "$f" && echo '|||'; done | head -50000

nodes.name: 解析审查记录
nodes.expression: (function() { const output = nodes.collect_reviews.output.stdout || ''; const parts = output.split('|||').map(p => p.trim()).filter(Boolean); const all = []; for (const p of parts) { try { const obj = JSON.parse(p); if (obj && (obj.review_id || obj.signoff_id || obj.acceptance_id)) all.push(obj); } catch (e) {} } const period = nodes.intake.output.period || { start: '', end: '' }; const start = period.start ? new Date(period.start + 'T00:00:00.000Z').getTime() : null; const end = period.end ? new Date(period.end + 'T23:59:59.999Z').getTime() : null; const inRange = (iso) => { if (!iso) return true; const t = new Date(iso).getTime(); if (Number.isNaN(t)) return true; if (start != null && t < start) return false; if (end != null && t > end) return false; return true; }; const reviews = all.filter(r => inRange(r.completed_at || r.completedAt || r.created_at || r.started_at || '')); return { reviews, total: reviews.length, total_raw: all.length, period }; })()

nodes.name: 分类统计审查
nodes.expression: (function() { const reviews = nodes.parse_reviews.output.reviews || []; const hasPrefix = (v, p) => typeof v === 'string' && v.startsWith(p); const codeReviews = reviews.filter(r => hasPrefix(r.review_id, 'CR-')); const designReviews = reviews.filter(r => hasPrefix(r.review_id, 'DR-')); const qaSignoffs = reviews.filter(r => hasPrefix(r.signoff_id, 'QA-')); const crPassed = codeReviews.filter(r => r.result === 'APPROVED').length; const drPassed = designReviews.filter(r => r.result === 'APPROVED').length; const qaPassed = qaSignoffs.filter(r => r.result === 'PASSED' || r.result === 'PARTIAL').length; return { code_review: { total: codeReviews.length, passed: crPassed, failed: codeReviews.length - crPassed, avg_score: codeReviews.length > 0 ? Math.round(codeReviews.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.score || 0), 0) / codeReviews.length) : 0 }, design_review: { total: designReviews.length, passed: drPassed, failed: designReviews.length - drPassed, avg_score: designReviews.length > 0 ? Math.round(designReviews.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.score || 0), 0) / designReviews.length) : 0 }, qa_signoff: { total: qaSignoffs.length, passed: qaPassed, failed: qaSignoffs.length - qaPassed }, all_reviews: reviews }; })()

nodes.name: 收集任务状态
nodes.description: 扫描 taskpacks 目录统计任务
nodes.command: find design/ai-native/03_taskpacks -name '*.md' -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l && find design/ai-native/03_taskpacks -name '*.md' -type f 2>/dev/null | head -50

nodes.name: 收集问题列表
nodes.description: 从审查记录中提取阻塞/警告
nodes.expression: (function() { const reviews = nodes.categorize_reviews.output.all_reviews || []; const blockers = reviews.filter(r => r && (r.result === 'REJECTED' || r.result === 'FAILED')); const warnings = reviews.filter(r => r && (r.result === 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' || r.result === 'REVISION_REQUIRED')); return { blockers, warnings, blocker_count: blockers.length, warning_count: warnings.length }; })()

nodes.name: 生成验收摘要
nodes.expression: (function() { const stats = nodes.categorize_reviews.output; const taskCount = parseInt(nodes.collect_tasks.output.stdout.split('\n')[0]) || 0; const hasBlockers = (nodes.collect_issues.output.blocker_count || 0) > 0; const overallPassRate = (stats.code_review.total + stats.design_review.total + stats.qa_signoff.total) > 0 ? Math.round(((stats.code_review.passed + stats.design_review.passed + stats.qa_signoff.passed) / (stats.code_review.total + stats.design_review.total + stats.qa_signoff.total)) * 100) : 100; return { tasks_total: taskCount, code_review_pass_rate: stats.code_review.total > 0 ? Math.round((stats.code_review.passed / stats.code_review.total) * 100) + '%' : 'N/A', design_review_pass_rate: stats.design_review.total > 0 ? Math.round((stats.design_review.passed / stats.design_review.total) * 100) + '%' : 'N/A', qa_pass_rate: stats.qa_signoff.total > 0 ? Math.round((stats.qa_signoff.passed / stats.qa_signoff.total) * 100) + '%' : 'N/A', overall_pass_rate: overallPassRate + '%', avg_code_review_score: stats.code_review.avg_score, has_blockers: hasBlockers, details: stats }; })()

nodes.name: 判定验收决策
nodes.expression: (function() { const summary = nodes.generate_summary.output; const passRate = parseInt(summary.overall_pass_rate) || 0; if (summary.has_blockers) { return { decision: 'HOLD', reason: '存在阻塞问题需要先解决' }; } else if (passRate >= 90) { return { decision: 'PROCEED', reason: '验收通过，可以进入下一阶段' }; } else if (passRate >= 70) { return { decision: 'CONDITIONAL', reason: '有条件通过，需要跟踪问题修复' }; } else { return { decision: 'HOLD', reason: '通过率过低，建议暂停推进' }; } })()

nodes.name: 生成进度报告
nodes.expression: ({ type: 'progress', milestone_id: inputs.milestone_id, period: nodes.intake.output.period, summary: nodes.generate_summary.output, highlights: ['审查体系运行正常', '代码质量整体良好'], concerns: nodes.generate_summary.output.has_blockers ? ['存在未解决的阻塞问题'] : [], next_steps: nodes.determine_decision.output.decision === 'PROCEED' ? ['启动下一里程碑'] : ['修复阻塞问题', '补充缺失的审查'] })

nodes.name: 生成问题报告
nodes.expression: (function() { const reviews = nodes.categorize_reviews.output.all_reviews || []; const blockers = reviews.filter(r => r && (r.result === 'REJECTED' || r.result === 'FAILED' || (Array.isArray(r.blocking_issues) && r.blocking_issues.length > 0))); const warnings = reviews.filter(r => r && (r.result === 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' || r.result === 'REVISION_REQUIRED')); return { type: 'issues', milestone_id: inputs.milestone_id, blockers: blockers.map(r => ({ id: r.review_id || r.signoff_id || r.acceptance_id, target: r.task_id || r.doc_path || r.milestone_id, issues: r.issues || r.blocking_issues || [] })), warnings: warnings.map(r => ({ id: r.review_id || r.signoff_id || r.acceptance_id, target: r.task_id || r.doc_path || r.milestone_id, issues: r.issues || [] })), tech_debt: { todo_count: 0, fixme_count: 0, skip_test_count: 0 } }; })()

nodes.name: 生成最终验收报告
nodes.expression: ({ acceptance_id: nodes.intake.output.acceptance_id, milestone_id: inputs.milestone_id, result: nodes.determine_decision.output.decision === 'PROCEED' ? 'ACCEPTED' : (nodes.determine_decision.output.decision === 'CONDITIONAL' ? 'CONDITIONAL' : 'REJECTED'), reviewer: inputs.reviewer, period: nodes.intake.output.period, summary: nodes.generate_summary.output, decision: nodes.determine_decision.output, progress_report: nodes.generate_progress_report.output, issue_report: nodes.generate_issue_report.output, recommendations: [nodes.determine_decision.output.reason], completed_at: new Date().toISOString() })

nodes.name: 构建 Markdown 进度报告
nodes.expression: (function() { const accId = nodes.intake.output.acceptance_id; const milestone = inputs.milestone_id; const now = new Date().toISOString(); const period = nodes.intake.output.period; const summary = nodes.generate_summary.output; const decision = nodes.determine_decision.output; const nextSteps = (nodes.generate_progress_report.output && nodes.generate_progress_report.output.next_steps) ? nodes.generate_progress_report.output.next_steps : []; const fmtList = (items, emptyText = '- （无）') => { const list = (items || []).map(s => String(s).trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 20); if (!list.length) return emptyText; return list.map(s => '- ' + s).join('\n'); }; const md = [ `# 进度报告 - ${milestone}`, '', `> acceptance_id: ${accId}`, `> 生成时间: ${now}`, `> 统计周期: ${period.start} ~ ${period.end}`, '', '## 总体进度', `- 任务总数: ${summary.tasks_total}`, `- 代码审查通过率: ${summary.code_review_pass_rate}`, `- 设计审查通过率: ${summary.design_review_pass_rate}`, `- QA签字通过率: ${summary.qa_pass_rate}`, `- 综合通过率: ${summary.overall_pass_rate}`, `- 平均代码审查分数: ${summary.avg_code_review_score}`, '', '## 决策建议', `- **决策**: ${decision.decision}`, `- **原因**: ${decision.reason}`, '', '## 下一步', fmtList(nextSteps), '' ].join('\n'); return { content: md }; })()

nodes.name: 保存 Markdown 进度报告
